reconcile.note: John Gill treats Isaac as Abraham's only legitimate son and heir by his wife Sarah, not a denial that Ishmael and Keturah's sons ever existed.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Julius Wellhausen reads the Akedah's only-son wording as evidence of a documentary seam, a narrative strand that simply did not reckon Ishmael as a co-heir.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Julius Wellhausen (1885), Prolegomena to the History of Israel (1885).

sides.snippet: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
sides.verseText: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

sides.snippet: Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac
sides.verseText: He said, \"Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there for a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.\"
